messages:
tyler: incoming batch of API feature asks from Support/Sales:
- AcmeCorp: needs streaming chat responses with mid-stream tool calls + deterministic JSON schema enforcement
- FinServCo: wants function/tool calling to trigger external billing systems with guaranteed exactly-once semantics
- MosaicApps: wants granular partial-output frames for progressive UI

anna: thanks. can you paste ticket IDs and if any are paying customers? :eyes:

tyler: Tickets: #4723 (Acme, enterprise contract), #4789 (FinServ, POC but large), #4812 (Mosaic, commercial). Acme already threatened to move backlog unless we support their use-case.

sarah: Acme is on a contract renewal cycle next quarter. high revenue risk if delayed.

kevin: high level: streaming + tool-calls + schema validation touches runtime, SDKs, and routing. tricky parts:
- tool-calls in mid-stream require preserved KV-cache and rollback semantics for retries
- exactly-once for external calls means idempotency tokens and at-least-once delivery safeguards
- partial-output frames affect batching heuristics

oliver: rough eng estimate: 3-5 wks for a scoped pilot to handle streaming outputs with callback hooks, additional 2-3 sprints for robust retries/idempotency + tests. unknowns: third-party connector patterns.

jamie: devex impact: SDK changes (streaming events for tool-call lifecycle), docs and sample apps. need a migration guide.

anna: proposal: create a dedicated ticket in roadmap board, split into two milestones:
1) Pilot (P1 for Acme): minimal streaming + tool callback with an opt-in flag, acceptance criteria + test harness
2) GA (P2): schema enforcement, idempotency primitives, SDK integrations, monitoring + rollback policy

kevin: agree. we should gate Pilot by: end-to-end demo with Acme, integration test for retry semantics, and no regression on 95th percentile latency for normal chat routes.

anna: i'll own spec + PM. kevin you lead eng. tyler please own coordination with Support/Sales and get sample prompts/data. jamie own SDK work. target: pilot spec and spike by 2026-05-08. add risk: legal review for external callbacks.

ops-bot: created issue #PR-2301 and assigned tags: pilot, streaming, customer-request.

tyler: filed tickets + shipped sample payloads to #PR-2301. i'll add a short customer acceptance checklist.

anna: perfect. locking in priorities for next planning. we'll evaluate after pilot whether to push to GA. :thumbsup:
